name: HARPREET SINGH
player_statement:
A complete player, HARPREET SINGH has made a big mark in cricket. With 59 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 95*, with an average of 18.40 and a quick strike rate of 69.86. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 11 sixes and 73 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 255.1 overs, taking 76 wickets at an economy rate of 5.46. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
